method: Each rendered PNG page was individually opened with view_image and visually inspected. Text extraction was not used as a substitute for visual inspection.
checks: Readable Cyrillic and Latin text with no missing glyphs
No clipped text or table content
No overlapping text, rows, headers or footers
Headings remain with their associated content
All tables remain inside the page margins
Table continuation repeats the column header

pages.notes: Seven table rows, introductory text and reading guide fit clearly on one page.
Eleven table rows and explanatory notes are readable and clear of the footer.
First fifteen rows of the split table fit within the page. The final row has adequate clearance above the footer.
The continued table repeats its header, includes the four remaining rows and keeps the reading guide together.
Long title, introduction, nine table rows and notes are all readable without overlap or clipping.
Thirteen table rows and the reading guide remain inside the margins with separation from the footer.
Eleven table rows and the Message-related introduction and notes fit clearly.
Long title, six table rows and explanatory notes are fully visible and readable.
Ten table rows and explanatory text have clear alignment and spacing.
Four table rows, introduction and reading guide are readable with ample page margins.

limitations: This review verifies the visual layout of the provided final page renders. It does not certify runtime execution of the compared code or independently recalculate the source-size metrics.
